name: Guangzhou Ruili Kormee Automotive Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Ruili Kormee Automotive Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of automobile electronic control systems in China. It offers anti-skid brake systems (ABS), electronically controlled brake systems (EBS), emergency braking systems (AEBS), electronic stability controllers (ESC), and electrical park brakes (EPB), as well as is involved in the research and development, production, sales, and service of tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS) and eddy current retarders. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
